keyset.tutorial.intro.title: Keyset
keyset.tutorial.intro.body: Save complete keybind layouts as profiles, switch between them instantly, clean up conflicts, and auto-switch when you join servers.
keyset.tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to Keyset
keyset.tutorial.welcome.body: Keyset lets you save multiple keybind layouts as profiles. Each profile is a full snapshot of your bindings — PvP, building, creative, whatever you need. You can switch between them instantly.
keyset.tutorial.create.title: Step 1 — Create a Profile
keyset.tutorial.create.body: Click + New in the sidebar to create your first profile. Give it a name that makes sense, like 'PvP' or 'Creative'. Profiles remember every keybind exactly as it is when you save.
keyset.tutorial.rename.title: Step 2 — Rename It
keyset.tutorial.rename.body: Good names matter when you have 5+ profiles. Select the profile you just created and click Rename to give it a proper name. You can also reorder profiles with the ↑ ↓ buttons.
keyset.tutorial.rename.hint: → Select the profile, then click Rename
keyset.tutorial.activate.title: Step 3 — Activate a Profile
keyset.tutorial.activate.body: Activating a profile applies its stored bindings to your game RIGHT NOW. The LIVE chip shows which profile is currently active. Only one profile can be live at a time.
keyset.tutorial.conflicts.title: Step 4 — Check for Conflicts
keyset.tutorial.conflicts.body: A conflict is when two actions share the same key — pressing it triggers both. The Conflicts tab shows all conflicts from your CURRENT bindings, live. Open it to see what's clashing.
keyset.tutorial.fix.title: Step 5 — Fix a Conflict
keyset.tutorial.fix.body: Click any conflicting binding to open its detail dialog. You can Clear the binding, Rebind it to a different key, or Jump to vanilla Controls. Fixing conflicts makes your layout cleaner.
keyset.tutorial.fix.hint: → Click a conflict row (or skip if none exist)
keyset.tutorial.savelive.title: Step 6 — Save Live
keyset.tutorial.savelive.body: Made changes in Minecraft's own Controls screen? Keyset won't know about them until you Save Live. This captures your CURRENT bindings into the selected profile.
keyset.tutorial.savelive.hint: → Click Save Live in the sidebar
keyset.tutorial.autoswitch.title: Step 7 — Auto-Switch
keyset.tutorial.autoswitch.body: Keyset can automatically switch profiles when you join a server. Set a rule like 'hypixel.net → PvP profile' and it switches the moment you connect. Open the Auto-Switch tab to set this up.
keyset.tutorial.done.title: You're ready!
keyset.tutorial.done.body: You know how to create, activate, and save profiles, fix conflicts, and set up auto-switch. Use the ? button any time to revisit this guide. Go build your perfect layout.
